title: Local block normal form of continuous-coefficient module maps
statement: Let E be any normed field, V any scheme, R an abelian ring sheaf, e an invertible monoid morphism to the continuous E-function ring sheaf, and f:R^m to R^n. If its continuous matrix has locally constant pointwise rank, a pro-etale cover C exists such that the pulled-back source and target are isomorphic to R_i^r plus R_i^s and R_i^r plus R_i^t, respectively, and pulled-back f equals a.hom followed by the block map diag(identity,zero) followed by b.inv.

proof.text: Apply continuousField_exists_isOpen_eq_mul_of_locallyConstant to the continuous presentation matrix at each point. Choose the resulting neighbourhood, rank and injective row/column selections. The neighbourhoods form a Zariski cover, hence a pro-etale cover.

Apply the prescribed matrix factorization to the continuous map from each chosen open subscheme. Its image lies in the chosen neighbourhood, yielding the invertible matrices P,Q and the exact factorization.
Invoke continuousField_matrix_sheaf_normalForm on the open immersion and these matrices. Its source/target isomorphisms give the required normal form on each cover member.
